one_line: Show the finished handmade card first, then the whole make from above in one fixed shot.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down: a finished white card in a hand, with twelve painted honey jars, apples and pomegranates and handwritten "שנה טובה ומתיקה" and "חג שמח". No overlay text, no speech. 0:02 cut to a blank sheet and a watercolour palette.
q1_hook.why: The finished card fills the frame, so the result sells the process and invites "how is it made?" (H2, H5). The card's own handwriting shows the skill. But there is no overlay text naming the topic (against T3), no voice (H4), and no brand or product yet (H3).

beats.what: The finished card held in a hand
A blank sheet and a watercolour palette; a brush paints coloured dots in rows
beats.why: A calm, repeating action with a growing pattern

beats.what: The Giotto Turbo Soft Brush box appears; a black marker outlines the dots into jars, apples and pomegranates
beats.why: The dots turn into recognisable shapes, a visible change

beats.what: The marker writes the greeting "שנה טובה ומתיקה"; the Reel ends mid-writing
beats.why: The last step links back to the opening card

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: "אהבתן? ❤️ תשמרו להשראה" (a save ask). Nothing in the video.
q2_flow.why: The finished card at 0:00 opens a "how is it made" loop that the next 16 s close step by step (H5, K2). Dots turning into shapes at 0:09-0:13 is the best moment. There is no new picture type after 0:08, and it stops mid-writing without a final look at the card (R3, R4).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption, near the end: "אהבתן? ❤️ תשמרו להשראה 🥰".
q3_cta.why: One soft save ask suits a craft worth returning to (C1, R7). It is not said or shown in the video (against C6), and "אהבתן?" is a closed question, not one answered from the viewer's own life (C5).

q4_shown.what: The finished card 0:00-0:01; a blank sheet and a watercolour palette 0:02; a brush painting twelve coloured dots 0:02-0:07; the Giotto Turbo Soft Brush box at the top of the frame and the black marker adding outlines and handwriting 0:08-0:16. Hands only; no price.
q4_shown.why: Result first, then the full process from blank paper, shows the skill needed is low (H2, K4). The marker's benefit, brush-like control, is shown only as handwriting. The brand box sits in the frame for about half the Reel, well above a quarter (C7, H3).

q5_edit.what: 3 shots in 17 s: the finished card (0-1.5 s), a fixed top-down shot with the palette, then a cut at about 8 s when the marker box appears. It looks time-lapsed (not verified). No text, no speech. It ends mid-writing with no end card.
q5_edit.why: A fixed top-down view with only two cuts gives a calm, easy-to-follow make, each cut matching a new step (E2, R3, F8). With no text or voice, nothing announces the topic (E4, T1). It ends mid-writing, without a last look at the finished card (R4, E8).

q6_topic.what: A Rosh Hashana card made with watercolours and brush markers, a seasonal craft anyone can copy; it serves people who want a handmade holiday greeting.
q6_topic.why: A dated seasonal need (K7) with a calm, satisfying process, and a "no experience needed" message that appears only in the caption (K4). The mood is low in arousal and there is no story or child (K1, K2).

q7_filmed.what: A fixed top-down shot of a white table in bright even light, a hand entering from the right; the palette and then the marker box sit at the top edge; the opening shot is the card in a hand. Phone apparently propped above the table.
q7_filmed.why: A propped overhead phone and white paper give a sharp, clean frame where the colours stand out (F5, F7, S4). The hand and marker fill the frame (F4). A plain home setup with no studio props looks native (H8).

q8_text.on_screen: No overlay text. The only words are on the product: the handwritten "שנה טובה ומתיקה" and "חג שמח" on the finished card (0:00-0:01) and the same greeting being written at 0:14-0:16; the box reads "GIOTTO Turbo Soft Brush".
q8_text.caption: "כרטיס ברכה לראש השנה 🍎🍯". About 79 words in short paragraphs: what was made, why the markers are special ("מכחול שמוציא צבע"), "כל אחת יכולה להכין", a save ask, 5 hashtags (#roshhashana #cardcraft #ראשהשנה #צבעימים #כרטיסברכה), then "בשיתוף @giotto_israel".
q8_text.why: With no overlay text, the topic and benefit appear only in the caption, so a muted or fast-scrolling viewer gets no words (against T1, T3). The caption's first line names the craft and holiday in search words, with 5 hashtags (T7), and the disclosure is in words but in the last line (T8).

weak_points: No overlay text or voice, so the topic and the markers' benefit are only in the caption; the brand box fills the frame for about half the Reel; no last look at the finished card; disclosure in the last line.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the finished page first, then one fixed top-down take of hands doing the one step that matters, with a short text line naming it. End on the finished page.
not_verified: Whether the video is sped up; the creator's identity; music (the transcript is only "תודה רבה", so there is no speech). The greeting is quoted as it appears on the card. The last frame at 0:16 shows the greeting still being written.
